description: This file provides utilities for post-processing Triton Proton profiling trace files, including functions for reading, writing, grouping, normalizing, and transforming trace data for visualization and analysis. It offers specialized handling of event grouping by SM and CTA, timestamp normalization, and invocation splitting.

methods.name: None _write_trace(path: str, data: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Writes trace data to a gzipped JSON file.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _read_trace(path: str)
methods.description: Reads trace data from a JSON file, supporting gzipped or plain JSON formats.

methods.name: str _get_base_name(trace_path: str)
methods.description: Extracts the base name of a trace file, removing known extension patterns.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] _group_events_by_sm(events: list[dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Groups events so that all CTAs on the same SM share one track, adjusting 'pid' and 'tid' fields accordingly.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] _group_events_per_cta_occupancy( events: list[dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Processes warp events into CTA-level events with slot assignment, generating per-CTA and per-SM event tracks for visualization.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] _apply_grouping( events: list[dict[str, Any]], group_by_sm: bool, per_cta_occupancy: bool )
methods.description: Applies event grouping transformations based on specified flags (by SM or per CTA occupancy).

methods.name: list[list[dict[str,Any]]] _split_events_by_invocation( events: list[dict[str, Any]], gap_threshold_ns: float = 1000.0, )
methods.description: Splits a list of events into separate invocations based on time gaps.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] _normalize_timestamps( events: list[dict[str, Any]], scale_factor: float = 1.0 )
methods.description: Normalizes event timestamps to start at zero and applies optional scaling.

methods.name: list[str] process_proton_trace( trace_path: str, output_dir: str | None = None, group_by_sm: bool = True, split_invocations: bool = True, scale_factor: float = 1.0, gap_threshold_ns: float = 1000.0, per_cta_occupancy: bool = True, )
methods.description: Main function that processes a Proton trace file with options for grouping, splitting invocations, timestamp scaling, and CTA occupancy processing. Produces one complete trace file and optionally per-invocation trace files.

ctags.name: _apply_grouping
ctags.signature: ( events: list[dict[str, Any]], group_by_sm: bool, per_cta_occupancy: bool )

ctags.name: process_proton_trace
ctags.signature: ( trace_path: str, output_dir: str | None = None, group_by_sm: bool = True, split_invocations: bool = True, scale_factor: float = 1.0, gap_threshold_ns: float = 1000.0, per_cta_occupancy: bool = True, )
